policy: Every UI task records an applied/not_applicable/unavailable decision for each entry. Source review is distinct from installing or executing a tool.

entries.name: Taste Skill
entries.notes: Mandatory design-direction review for every UI task. Source reviewed, scripts not executed. Reject static-export conversion and compulsory marketing choreography for this server-backed SaaS.

entries.name: Web Design Guidelines
entries.notes: Mandatory UI correctness/accessibility review. Wrapper points to current web-interface-guidelines/command.md; refresh that actual source for each new audit. Local wrapper .agents/skills/web-design-guidelines/SKILL.md is installed.

entries.name: Image-to-code
entries.notes: Moved out of taste-skill. Apply visual extraction and comparison when the task has a visual source; otherwise record not_applicable. Never claim the converter ran merely because instructions were read.

entries.name: Awesome DESIGN.md
entries.notes: Mandatory visual-system documentation reference. Catalog reviewed; separate static Linear study informed structure only. Cloud skill read via canonical package URI; selected Linear static study applied alongside primary source review. No claim of reviewing every catalog entry.

entries.name: Playwright CLI / browser testing
entries.notes: Mandatory rendered-browser verification where runtime works. CLI source reviewed, not installed/run; installed Playwright library + system Chromium used for actual captures. Source-only or blocked checks remain explicit.

entries.name: Refero
entries.notes: Attio style d2774b0c-b85e-43b6-95e2-1da6c69bb504 inspected by lead agent. Competitor search was mixed; catalog references are not live authenticated-app evidence. Do not install refero-design without required approval.

entries.name: Mobbin
entries.notes: Dropbox iOS sharing/access sheets inspected from downloaded full-resolution images; PandaDoc document list adjacent reference. No collections or comments written. Preserve canonical citations and any required usage notice.

entries.name: Better Design
entries.source: Connected Better Design MCP (service URL not independently established)
entries.resolvedSource: Connected Better Design MCP (service URL not independently established)
entries.notes: Rules and feature map consulted; local feature map is .better-design/feature-map.json. No global team rule is written without a concrete approved draft. Service version not exposed.

entries.name: UXPilot
entries.notes: Read-only user-flow evidence inspected by lead agent (27 nodes). No claim of regenerated production UI, global defaults, or writes. Record the exact artifact in each future task.

entries.name: shadcn/ui
entries.notes: Mandatory local-component/API review. Roomline owns customized Radix components on Next14/React18/Tailwind3, not current React19/Tailwind4/Base UI examples. No bulk registry overwrite.

entries.name: 21st CLI / component registry / MCP
entries.notes: MCP config is environment-only (${API_KEY_21ST}); CLI installed by tooling agent. Authenticated search remains unavailable until a fresh rotated key is configured. Use scripts/design/21st-mcp.mjs to initialize/list/schema-check before component search; review source/dependencies before adoption. Never run returned code automatically.

entries.name: UXCritique
entries.notes: No callable UXCritique tool identified. Use a documented project-specific UX review and record unavailable; do not relabel it as execution of this tool.

entries.name: Intuitive Software Design
entries.source: User-named Intuitive Software Design (no verified endpoint supplied)
entries.resolvedSource: User-named Intuitive Software Design (no verified endpoint supplied)
entries.notes: No callable tool identified. Record an explicit unavailable decision until an authoritative source or integration is connected.

entries.name: Design System
entries.notes: Generic Design System request is fulfilled by Roomline DESIGN.md, semantic tokens, local component recipes and evidence. It is not a claim that an external plugin named Design System was invoked.

entries.name: imperial_masters_cv
entries.source: User-provided name imperial_masters_cv (document not available locally)
entries.resolvedSource: User-provided name imperial_masters_cv (document not available locally)
entries.notes: No local file was supplied. Exact-name connected Drive lookup required reauthentication; no personal context inferred and no invented CV contents used.

entries.name: Hallmark
entries.notes: README/skill/redesign/portable design system reviewed. Preserve product contracts and scoped design tokens; no remote engine executed.

entries.name: Astryx
entries.notes: Reviewed 0.7.17 source. React>=19 and StyleX architecture is incompatible with installing unchanged in React18; adopt semantic token/state principles only.

entries.name: Rune
entries.notes: Rust native GPU UI framework on pre-release dev branch, not a drop-in React library. Interaction semantics can inform web UI. Native implementation requires actual native project source.

entries.name: Unslop
entries.notes: Craft-pass guidance source reviewed, not installed. CC BY 4.0 by Damir Sokolovsky; retain attribution on adaptations. Product-specific hierarchy beats blanket aesthetic bans.

entries.name: Logiaweb Design Inspo Stack
entries.notes: Editorial guide dated 2026-10-04; sections/flow/reasoned-reference method adopted. Reachability does not license external assets, paid catalogs, or unrelated Mac tools.

entries.name: Requested jaimedhenriques/ui
entries.notes: API/URL redirect resolves to hythevc/ui. Reviewed shadcn source fork; latest React19/Next16/Tailwind4 examples require adaptation, not overwrite. Metadata reachability/visibility can vary with authentication.

entries.name: Screenshot to Code
entries.notes: Separate Python/FastAPI + React/Vite conversion app. Source reviewed; no provider calls/keys or conversion server run. Use capture/compare discipline when visual source is relevant.

entries.name: AI Website Cloner Template
entries.notes: Inspection/geometry verification guidance reviewed. Next16/React19/Tailwind4 template is not an upgrade recipe or permission to copy competitor identity.

entries.name: Anti-slop
entries.notes: Core/UI/mobile/accessibility/copy/comment guidance reviewed. Apply meaningful content, complete states and behavior; preserve MIT/Addy Osmani notices where material is copied.

entries.name: SkillUI
entries.notes: Source reviewed at package1.3.4. Static extraction/inferred design docs are inputs, not approved requirements. CLI not executed; README/package declare MIT but no standalone license established.

entries.name: Elaya AI Design Skills
entries.notes: Landing/Figma foundations/tokens reviewed. Do not impose gradient headlines, font bans, 500ms transitions, or scroll reveals on Roomline operations.

entries.name: Emil Kowalski Skills / Apple Design
entries.notes: Apple-design explicitly applies principles to web. Use instant feedback, restrained frequency-aware motion, Pointer Events and mobile-web clarity. No SwiftUI rewrite or Apple asset license implied.

entries.name: UX/UI Agent Skills / XIAS
entries.notes: Tokens/state/evidence guidance reviewed. Next15/React19 adapter incompatible wholesale. Kit self-test accuracy_report is not a Roomline quality score.

entries.name: Impeccable
entries.notes: Persuade/Operate/Read modes and hardening reviewed. No detector, installer, bypassed live-copy hook, or self-downloading engine executed.

entries.name: UI/UX Pro Max
entries.notes: Source/design-system/styling reviewed. Accessibility and interaction precede style. No toolkit database search or generated score claimed; avoid Tailwind4/new-app migration recipes.

entries.name: Taste Skill website
entries.notes: Website is overview/examples and may differ from current repository script generation. Use pinned repository workflow notes; do not treat marketing claims as Roomline measurements.

entries.name: 12ui Design
entries.notes: Cloud skill was read in the initial task. No CLI/design run is established by this review. Use its applicable design workflow when available; document unavailable status rather than silently claiming generation.

entries.name: Product Design
entries.notes: Router/audit instructions were read in the initial task. Existing code and current captures ground this work; source research is not a completed authenticated-product audit.

entries.name: Installed frontend-design skill
entries.notes: Local skill available for frontend implementation. Read its actual instructions when invoked and reconcile them with Roomline design/compatibility constraints.
